competitorReviews.author: Marcus K., Verified Buyer
competitorReviews.reviewText: Do not buy! The left ear cup started crackling and dropping connection after 3 weeks. Contacted their support 4 times and got zero human response, just automated bots.
competitorReviews.actionableHook: Frustrated by robotic support and dying headphones? AuraSound gives you 24/7 human VIP care.

competitorReviews.author: Elena R., Content Creator
competitorReviews.reviewText: Took 18 days to arrive even with express shipping. When it got here the spacebar squeaks loud enough to pick up on my stream mic. Super disappointed for $95.
competitorReviews.actionableHook: Tired of squeaky budget stabilizers ruining your stream? ZenType ships in 48h with factory-lubed silence.

competitorReviews.author: David W., Remote Nomad
competitorReviews.reviewText: Plugged in my MacBook and iPad at the airport and this charger became scalding hot. It actually throttled down to a trickle charge. Definitely not travel safe.
competitorReviews.actionableHook: Never settle for dangerous overheated bricks. VoltFlex uses Aerospace graphene cooling that never throttles.

competitorReviews.author: Jessica M., College Athlete
competitorReviews.reviewText: Leaked cold brew all over my laptop in my gym bag! The lid threading is poorly molded. Also, customer service refused a return because it was opened.
competitorReviews.actionableHook: 100% Guaranteed Leak-Proof or we replace it free. The HydroVibe double-threaded locking seal will never spill.

competitorReviews.author: Samir B.
competitorReviews.reviewText: They dropped the price by $25 right after I bought it, but wouldn't honor a price adjustment. Sneaky business model.
competitorReviews.actionableHook: Transparent pricing with a 30-day Price Match & Happiness Guarantee.
